findings.summary: The test pins neither claimed property: it never declares two different sources and never runs concurrent calls.
evidence: The commit replaces one sync.Once shared by every source with a mutex-guarded map keyed by source (cmd_mcp.go:129-160); the test calls only source memorycard, sequentially, for ids 1 and 3 (promote_memorycard_test.go:351-355).
Collapsing the map back to one boolean would still pass the test, and removing the lock would not fail it, since nothing runs concurrently.
The check, the set and the write happen under one lock, so concurrent calls declare each source at most once; the runtime logic reads correct, the gap is test adequacy.
No package-level declared-once state remains. Tests and race detector not run by the polisher.
